# W14 text-fill alpha

Original paired body/WPS controls generated by `tools/text_fill_alpha_fixture.py`
from this repository's independently authored shape-tables package. No corpus
text, photos, third-party engine, or font binary is redistributed. The reference application exported all twelve pages of `control.docx` to `native.pdf`.
`tools/text_fill_alpha_reference.py` records PDF graphics-state alpha values,
body/shape raster-region color histograms, and source/reference hashes.

The twelve cases cover alpha 0, 1, 25000, 50000, 60000, 70000, 99999 and 100000,
repeated alpha in both orders, and theme-color luminance transforms before/after
alpha. Each page uses two different opaque backgrounds. The reference application converts translucent
glyphs to PDF paths, so text-extraction fill-color calls alone miss those cases.
Transparent endpoint regions contain only their background.

## Reference/spec divergence

[MS-DOCX CT_SchemeColor](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/openspecs/office_standards/ms-docx/133bd2fe-ad4c-4422-a120-9c3a1a3a4e30)
describes alpha as opacity. In these W14 text-fill controls the reference application instead treats
it as transparency: zero is opaque, 100000 is transparent. The final alpha
transform wins. The reference application quantizes transparency to a byte before inversion:
`opacityByte = 255 - round(alpha * 255 / 100000)`. Thus the PDF contains 0.74902,
0.49804, 0.4 and 0.29804 for source values 25000, 50000, 60000 and 70000.
This rule is confined to W14 text fill; DrawingML picture/shape alpha is unchanged.

The engine retains original XML and stores resolved translucent text fills as
RRGGBBAA. Explicit fill edits serialize a six-digit srgbClr plus W14 alpha that
reconstructs the same opacity byte. Ordinary foreground edits preserve fill.
The browser checks native interior colors within two channel levels and fully
transparent regions exactly, plus editing, undo and export/reopen. It does not
claim pixel identity of antialiased edges or certify every shadow/outline and
synthetic-font combination.
